h1.en: the Diesel Mixer Prints Three Stone Rows keeps its own figures; Conveyor belt is only the picture
h1.zh: 柴油搅拌泵的三行石子距离怎样读保留自己的数字，「傳動帶」只是配图

directAnswer.en: The diesel mixer concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists three distance rows. Stone capacity for ≤ 1 inch is written 100 / 300 m under a horizontal / vertical label. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conveyor_belt.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的柴油搅拌混凝土泵标出了三行距离。≤ 1 英寸的细石输送在水平/垂直标题下写成 100 / 300 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conveyor_belt。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conveyor_belt. The picture shows AlbertaSulfurAtVancouverBC. The diesel mixer concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists three distance rows. The unit m is written once at the end of each value. The same order applies to 60 / 180 m and 40 / 120 m. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³. Both are horizontal-then-vertical.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conveyor_belt。画面是AlbertaSulfurAtVancouverBC。河北品锦机械在邢台的柴油搅拌混凝土泵标出了三行距离。在 100 / 300 m 里，100 是水平，300 是垂直。

body.en: Stone capacity for ≤ 1 inch is written 100 / 300 m under a horizontal / vertical label. Output is 25 m³/h and the engine line is 4108 / 66–75 kW. Hebei Pinjin Machinery did not list the unit after the first number. The three rows change the distance, not the output entry. The characters still belong to the page that shown them.
body.zh: ≤ 1 英寸的细石输送在水平/垂直标题下写成 100 / 300 m。60 / 180 m 和 40 / 120 m 顺序相同。

body.en: The 13 mm row is 60 / 180 m. The label says horizontal / vertical. 25 m³/h is not split by stone size. Electric 60 writes 200 m / 600 m, with m after each number.
body.zh: 产量是 25 m³/h，发动机行是 4108 / 66–75 kW。河北品锦机械没有把单位标出在第一个数字后面。

body.en: The 24 mm row is 40 / 120 m. On 100 / 300 m, 100 is horizontal and 300 is vertical. Pressure is 23 MPa, also once. The diesel mixer writes 100 / 300 m.
body.zh: 不要把标点改成另一台泵的样式，再把改写当成原格。电动60写成 200 m / 600 m，每个数字后都有 m。

question.en: On this row: What is vertical on the first row?

answer.en: 300 m, in the value 100 / 300 m. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conveyor_belt.
answer.zh: 300 m，写在 100 / 300 m 里。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conveyor_belt画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: What is the 24 mm pair?

answer.en: 40 / 120 m, horizontal then vertical. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conveyor_belt.
answer.zh: 40 / 120 m，先水平后垂直。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conveyor_belt画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Is output different for each stone?
question.zh: 每种石子的产量不同吗？

answer.en: The page does not list three outputs. It lists 25 m³/h once. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conveyor_belt.
answer.zh: 页面没有标出三个产量。它只标出一次 25 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conveyor_belt画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Which engine line is on this page?
question.zh: 这一页的发动机行是什么？

answer.en: 4108 / 66–75 kW. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conveyor_belt.
